claims.name: dated-metadata-and-exact-combined-log-recovery
claims.statement: The dated primary and independent census agree on 1235 named-scope metadata rows. Four completed owned combined logs retain all 124012 content bytes and original modes in compressed evidence. Independent use passes before exact plain-file retirement and again afterward; fourteen distinguishing metadata/log/channel corruptions reject.
claims.scope: Eight explicit root/Rust/log scopes, with configured rust/target covered. Only the four manifest-named combined command logs are retired; every other candidate, cache, native product, tracked proof and other repository remains protected. Retained combined logs do not recreate the original stdout/stderr separation. Source template, census/index records, project instruments, command channels, archives, original modes, Git completion identities and residue receipt are explicit inputs. No whole-project population, global liveness, allocated/free-space reclamation, concurrent-adversarial guarantee or infrastructure/runtime change.

rederive.granularity: Each retained census path/suffix/byte row, each of four log bodies/modes/actual Git completion markers, exact retirement/residue and actual capture/replay/predelete/retirement channels.
